newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Two Moslems shot dead, Bosnian federation reports.
newsitem.headline: Two Moslems shot dead, Bosnian federation reports.

text.p: Two Bosnian Moslems were killed and another was wounded by automatic gunfire from unidentified gunmen in eastern Bosnia on Friday, Moslem-Croat federation authorities said.

The incident occurred near a former front line in a village inhabited by Serbs before the 1992-95 Bosnian war, the federation said. The NATO-led peace force said it could not confirm the incident and was investigating the report.
The federation Interior Ministry said the Moslems were "ambushed" at about 9 a.m. (0700 GMT) as they rode in a tractor on their way to cut firewood in the eastern Sapna region.
Four more Bosnians who were travelling along the same road earlier had also gone missing, it said.
The ministry demanded that the NATO-led Stabilisation Force (SFOR) "undertake urgent and energetic measures" to protect the eastern village of Laze.

The incident took place near the boundary line between Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation and the Serb entity. NATO peacekeeping troops patrol a zone of separation between the two territories and all weapons are supposed to be banned from the area.
